description: This Java class 'EngineReport' models a digital signal as a sequence of 'UpDown' events, providing parsing, time translation, and analysis functionalities related to engine signal waveforms.

classes.name: EngineReport
classes.description: Represents a sequence of digital signal events with parsing and time translation capabilities.

classes.name: EngineReport.UpDown
classes.description: Inner class representing a pair of up and down signal times with methods to compute duration and duty cycle.

methods.name: EngineReport
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the report from a string or list of UpDown events.

methods.name: isCloseEnough
methods.description: Checks if two double values are within a ratio threshold.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Returns the list of UpDown events.

methods.name: getMaxTime
methods.description: Returns the maximum timestamp in systicks.

methods.name: getMinTime
methods.description: Returns the minimum timestamp in systicks.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a report string into a list of UpDown events.

methods.name: timeToScreen
methods.description: Converts a time value to a screen coordinate.

methods.name: screenToTime
methods.description: Converts a screen coordinate back to a time value.

methods.name: getDuration
methods.description: Returns the duration of the signal in systicks.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the EngineReport.
